## Summary

Describe exactly what this PR changes and why.

## Related issue

Closes #<!-- issue number -->

If there is no issue, explain why this is a small, self-contained documentation or typo fix. PRs for new features or behavior changes should have a related issue and prior discussion.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and pull requests.
- [ ] This PR is focused on one related change.
- [ ] I have explained the motivation and user impact.
- [ ] I tested `index.html` in a current browser.
- [ ] I checked for console errors and broken links where relevant.
- [ ] I tested responsive behavior for visual changes.
- [ ] I added or updated documentation where needed.
- [ ] I removed personal information, secrets, and unnecessary generated files.
- [ ] I understand incomplete PRs may be closed so the change can be resubmitted with the required context.

## Testing details

List the browser, device, and steps used to test this change.
